ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 ratio of low-intensity dark pigments to high-intensity white localized marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark-gray/black contiguous field across both lobes. Localized high-contrast white linear streaks clustered on the inner-mid region of the left lobe. Scattered high-intensity white focal spots (1-3 pixel radius) distributed across the distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 55 degrees; depth is approximately 10% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (2-5 pixels) along the right lobe. Left lobe distal tip features a significant macro-indentation (notch) approximately 15 pixels deep.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the median notch to the tips; tips exhibit a slight posterior sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) located on the distal third of the right lobe and scattered near the center of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three distinct, parallel, diagonal white linear disruptions (approx. 40-60 pixels in length) on the left lobe, oriented towards the peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch/trauma mark on the far-left outer trailing edge; multiple white rake marks and circular parasitic/barnacle scars across the ventral surface.
